criteria.description: All five primitives exist as packages/styles/src/<name>/sk-<name>.css with generated barrels. Asserted by `node scripts/build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check` passing on a clean tree, and by the generated barrels containing one export per authored .html.
criteria.notes: Real script with a real exit code: node scripts/build-styles-only-markup.mjs --check. Verified in WP04 T023/T024.

criteria.description: Every primitive is demonstrated over real <dl>/<details>/<table>/<a> markup in its stories -- verified by grepping the authored .html for the native tag, not by reading story titles. .sk-empty-state has no single required native tag by design (FR-005; a plain block container).
criteria.notes: Verified per-primitive in WP01/WP02/WP03, and mission-wide (all five, with per-tag match counts) in WP04 T025. Recorded grep output, not a committed CI script.

criteria.description: The narrow-width table keeps its headers and is keyboard-reachable: at a narrow viewport the scroll container (.sk-data-table__scroller) is focusable (tabindex="0"), has an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby), and <th scope> association is intact.
criteria.notes: Devtools/accessibility-tree inspection, recorded concretely (tool used, what was observed) -- see WP03 T018. Not an automated test; packages/styles has no test target.

criteria.description: packages/styles/src/index.ts exports every new primitive, verified by importing the package entry point and asserting each generated export name resolves. ALSO: packages/styles/package.json gains a ./<name>/* subpath export for each of the five new directories -- scripts/check-release-graph.mjs's checkSubpathCoverage is [ENFORCED] at ci-quality.yml:533 and fails one row per directory with no subpath export.
criteria.notes: Two parts: (1) an import-and-resolve check for the five new export names, committed as a real test or recorded verbatim in the PR body (packages/styles/project.json has no test target -- see WP04 T021); (2) node scripts/check-release-graph.mjs, a real script with a real exit code, for the package.json subpath coverage half. This second half was entirely absent from the mission's original plan.

criteria.description: The forced-colors baseline is committed and demonstrated: with forced colors emulated, the skip link on focus, the disclosure marker, and the data-table's zebra/hover row distinction all remain perceivable. (Table borders was the issue's original -- and wrong -- guess for the third location; measured, a plain border already survives forced-colors mode with zero author rule, while background-based zebra/hover flattens to Canvas.)
criteria.notes: Visual/devtools forced-colors emulation (Windows High Contrast, or Chromium devtools' 'Emulate CSS media feature forced-colors'), documented per story per WP02/WP03. Not an automated test.

criteria.description: No --sk-status-* or --sk-chart-* token is introduced. Verified by grep against packages/tokens/src/tokens.css.
criteria.notes: grep -n 'sk-status-|sk-chart-' packages/tokens/src/tokens.css -- a real command with a real (empty) expected result, recorded in WP04 T024. Also recorded as negative invariant C-002 below.

criteria.description: Normal gates pass -- stylelint, htmlhint, axe, the generated-artifact --check scripts, and scripts/check-release-graph.mjs ([ENFORCED] at ci-quality.yml:533, absent from the issue's original gate list). Before the final gate the branch rebases on the current train and regenerates shared artifacts.
criteria.notes: The full local gate suite in plan.md's 'Local gate commands' section, run and recorded in WP04 T024. This mission has no automated behaviour-test suite (packages/styles/project.json has no test target) -- this criterion's automated_test proof_type refers to the gate SCRIPTS themselves (stylelint, htmlhint, the generators' --check forms, check-release-graph.mjs), each a real command with a real exit code, not a unit-test harness.

negative_invariants.description: No sk-* custom element ships from this mission. Any impulse to wrap one of these five primitives in an element is the #92 regression.
Tone-free: no success/danger row or panel colouring, and no --sk-status-*/--sk-chart-* token is invented (epic #183 ruling).
No sorting, filtering, pagination, virtualization, row selection, column resizing, sticky columns, or JavaScript of any kind.
No Team Kitty or Factory Dashboard domain copy in any of the five new primitives.

LightMode stories wrap in class="sk-light", never data-theme="light" -- the attribute form activates nothing (#93). form-field's own LightMode story is a known, recorded exception to this that must NOT be copied; check-bullet's is the shape to copy.
